notes.body: Hotei is one of the Seven Lucky Gods, shown as a fat, laughing monk. His bulk and laugh mark Zenpei throughout.
notes.span: for all the world a Hotei, the squat laughing god, in a square sleeved robe

notes.body: A secretary in a Meiji ministry held an elite bureaucratic post, with rank that impressed old-fashioned ears. That is why Zenpei fusses over the title.
notes.span: The guest was a secretary in one of the ministries

notes.body: The Ikuta school is one of the two main schools of koto playing. The phrase marks the singing as trained and fashionable.
notes.span: poured forth, with practised ease, a phrase in the Ikuta manner

notes.body: Korin refers to Ogata Korin, known for bold pine and flower designs. Pines casting Korin-style shadows likens the shoji light to such a painting.
notes.span: the pines, heedless, cast Kōrin-style shadows across it

notes.body: Ninsei is the Kyoto potter Nonomura Ninsei, famed for enamelled earthenware. A Ninsei incense box would be a treasured tea-utensil.
notes.span: that Ninsei incense box you gave me before

notes.body: Tanyu is the Kano-school painter Kano Tanyu, whose work was a standard boast in a formal alcove. Soho names a vase-maker prized for tea flower-vases. The Three Evenings are three celebrated autumn-verse topics, here as a set of three scrolls.
notes.span: in the alcove his boast, a Tanyu, the set of three scrolls of the Three Evenings poems for all to look at

notes.body: Kinuta is a type of grey-green celadon, named after stone beaters for cloth. Kintame is a gold-rich lacquer finish, and makie is lacquer sprinkled with gold or silver powder, here plovers over waves.
notes.span: the stacked incense box in kintame lacquer said to be of Kamakura, set beside the kinuta celadon censer

notes.body: The Kijima coal mine is the government mine whose sale is being canvassed. Disposal meant its lease or sale to private buyers by application, where order and influence counted.
notes.span: The famous Kijima coal mine at any rate

notes.body: A cabinet ordinance was a government order laying down rules without a Diet law. Here it resets all mine applications, so only papers filed under its terms, first first, will count.
notes.span: and so it came to the issuing of a single cabinet ordinance

notes.body: A machiai was a house of assignation, often used for discreet political meetings. The earlier machiai affair is an earlier scandal of the same sort, now raising the risk of exposure.
notes.span: to the upstairs of a certain machiai, an assignation house

notes.body: Shimbashi was Tokyo's entertainment and assignation quarter by the railway terminus. Lodging there signals paid company after the cash payment.
notes.span: That night Tatsuya lodged in Shimbashi, as was his custom

data.say: Kept notes to rank, Hotei and Korin, vessels, mine procedure, machiai and Shimbashi, leaving repetitions and the withheld ending untouched.
